name: Caption Contest
description: AI generates silly scenarios. Players write captions, then vote on the funniest!

generate-scenario.instruction: Generate a brief, funny, absurd scenario that students could write a caption for. Something like 'A cat wearing a business suit gives a TED talk' or 'A penguin tries to order at a drive-through'. Return just the scenario text, nothing else. Make it school-appropriate and silly.

write-captions.prompt:
Write the funniest caption for this scenario:

{{generate-scenario.result}}

show-caption.message:
Caption {{_foreach.vote-loop.index}} of {{_foreach.vote-loop.total}}:

"{{_current.text}}"

Who do you think wrote this?
